name: electronic-catalog-maker
description: Interactive image-hotspot catalogs in a single portable SQLite file — click a spot on a diagram, see its row in a linked table. No backend, no install.

paragraphs: Turn any picture into a clickable catalog. Put hotspots on a photo or a diagram, link each one to a row of data (name, SKU, description, a Buy link), and keep the whole thing in one portable .ecatm file (Electronic CATalog Maker). No backend, no account, nothing to install — try the live demo or visit tapalog.com.
